text.en:
Creation
of the Anti-Hunger
The Anti-Hunger Task Force is hereby created composed of national government
agencies implementing the component programs of the Accelerated Hunger-Mitigation
(AHMP). The Task Force will closely work with faith-based organizations to
widen the reach of the program among the poor and hungry households in the National
Capital Region and the identified priority provinces of the country.
